audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 5 read Vladimir and rows 3-4 read Skill, while every corresponding why said the stage belongs to Neeko.
audit.why: The mirror audit (neeko__vladimir) set rows 1-5 to Neeko with row 0 Skill and row 6 Vladimir. That matches the kits: Neeko out-ranges Vladimir at 800 (Blooming Burst) and 1000 (Tangle-Barbs) with a 600-range Transfusion against her, and Pop Blossom is a bigger level-6 threat than Hemoplague. Vladimir's genuine ownership is the two-item drain-and-pool package, which is where the 54.9% over 286 games comes from.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped to Neeko in phases[N].side and win[N] as one paired atomic group; whys[0] and whys[5] rewritten so no row contradicts its own explanation.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] and phases[5].why treated Riftmaker as the moment the lane flips.
audit.why: Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s and still out-bursts a one-item Vladimir; the flip is the two-item window, not the first.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to place the flip at two items and to key the first-item window to her ult being spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text described Pop Blossom only as an AoE nuke against 'an unaware Vlad' and gave no concrete pool numbers.
audit.why: Riot's own R text says the preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised — Inherent Glamour therefore removes the wind-up tell entirely, which is the single most important thing in this matchup. Tangle-Barbs also roots for longer and travels faster after passing through a champion, so standing in line with the wave or a teammate makes the root worse. Sanguine Pool's 2 seconds of untargetable on 28s at rank 1 is the whole answer, and the mirror asked for those exact numbers to be stated.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names Inherent Glamour's hidden wind-up and gives the pool duration; phases[1].why and phases[2].why now carry the 12s Tangle-Barbs cooldown and its 1000-range line.

audit.why: Neeko is female and the rest of the entry uses 'her'.
audit.corrected: Pronoun corrected in both; identical character count so the band is unaffected.

edits.before: Her spike is scarier than yours here — Pop Blossom under an unaware Vlad is a massive AoE nuke, but if you pool the airborne moment you negate it entirely and can R-Q-E back once she's committed and cooldownless.
edits.after: Her spike beats yours — Pop Blossom knocks up and stuns, and Inherent Glamour hides the wind-up while she is disguised. Sanguine Pool's 2s untargetable is the answer: hold it for her leap, then R-Q-E while she is cooldownless.

notes: The mirror flagged an unverified claim that Neeko's W grants invisibility. Riot's W text here describes a clone plus bonus third-attack damage and move speed, with no stealth in the text and no stealth flag — so I wrote nothing about invisibility either. What IS in Riot's text and worth propagating champion-wide is that Inherent Glamour hides the Pop Blossom wind-up while she is disguised. Several other fields on this matchup still say 'his'/'he' for Neeko (breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, dontsFull[0].d, report[12].t); those are worth a champion-level pronoun pass rather than one-off edits.
